summary: The implementation covers most core requirements including frontend image upload, emotion/cartoon selectors, loading states, results display, and backend session/image storage. However, several key requirements are only partially implemented or missing: actual image transformation processing (both emotion and style), proper multi-stage result generation, side-by-side comparison labels, file size display, and processing status communication. The warm artistic theme is implemented but uses a different approach than the immutable index.css suggests.

missing_requirements.requirement: File size limits are enforced and displayed to users
missing_requirements.reason: While file size validation exists (10MB limit in useImageUpload.ts), the limit is not displayed to users in the ImageUpload component interface

missing_requirements.requirement: Image processing applies selected emotion transformation
missing_requirements.reason: Backend endpoint exists but no actual emotion transformation processing is implemented. The useTransformation hook uses mock delays and returns the same blob for all transformation stages

missing_requirements.requirement: Processing status is communicated to frontend
missing_requirements.reason: While loading states exist, there is no actual status communication from backend about transformation progress or completion stages

missing_requirements.requirement: Style transformation is applied to emotion-adjusted image
missing_requirements.reason: No actual cartoon style processing is implemented. The transformation workflow creates mock results with the same blob rather than applying style transformations

missing_requirements.requirement: Each style produces visually distinct results
missing_requirements.reason: Since no actual style processing exists, all cartoon styles would produce identical results (same blob)

missing_requirements.requirement: Ghibli-style transformation captures characteristic soft colors and hand-drawn aesthetics
missing_requirements.reason: No image processing implementation exists for any style including Ghibli-style

missing_requirements.requirement: Labels identify each stage of transformation
missing_requirements.reason: While titles exist ('Original', 'Emotion Applied', 'Final Result'), the acceptance criteria specifies labels should identify transformation stages more descriptively than generic titles

hallucinated_features.description: Pixel Art and Pop Art cartoon styles added beyond specified options
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest specifies exactly five styles: Ghibli-style, classic cartoon, anime, comic book, and watercolor. The implementation includes 'pixelArt' and 'popArt' instead of 'classic cartoon'

hallucinated_features.description: Custom warm sunset color palette in index.css
hallucinated_features.reason: The constraint specifies not to modify immutable frontend paths, yet a completely different warm sunset palette was created in frontend/src/index.css when frontend/index.css already exists with standard colors

hallucinated_features.description: Custom font families (Poppins, Inter) and playful typography implementation
hallucinated_features.reason: While REQ-10 requests playful typography, the implementation adds specific font families not requested in the BuildRequest and applies them via Tailwind config
